finding: Neither multihead nor decoupled outperforms v35 under the frozen matched-total-parameter budget. Decoupled improves only against the weaker independent-attitude full control.
diagnosis: Decoupled p/q centered waveform errors remain essentially unchanged; q segment mean error is larger. Local20ms rate prediction also does not improve. Independent attitude output breaks the original hard rate-integration consistency.
causal_limits: Does not identify a unique physical cause, prove sensor noise or poor coverage, or rule out other widths, parameter budgets, training budgets, objectives or kinematic constraints.
next_focus: Retain hard quaternion integration; continue observation-contract/high-frequency-p predictability and q recurrent/context diagnostics before further architecture sweeps.
